# Tendriller

> Give an agent a live web page with conversation, device inputs, and data streams. The public HTTP API works without a repository checkout or SDK.

Agents: read https://tendriller.dev/agent.md first. It contains the creation API,
authentication, publication, host wake setup, delivery probes, and event loop.
Create with POST https://tendriller.dev/api/tendrils using the owner's verified
GitHub or Google email; save the returned private handle. Share only page_url.
Interactive pages support streams and conversation together. Dashboard mode
allows publishing without a live conversation receiver; collector activity also
keeps a claimed ad-hoc dashboard from expiring while it is idle.
Open and claim the page before starting sustained collection (1 MiB of custom
stream retention before claim, 8 MiB after claim).

## Public interface

- [Agent guide](https://tendriller.dev/agent.md): Start here; full setup and recovery instructions.
- [Protocol](https://tendriller.dev/docs/PROTOCOL.md): HTTP and browser API reference.
- [JSON schemas](https://tendriller.dev/contract/v1.json): Executable request and response contracts.
- [Streams](https://tendriller.dev/docs/STREAMS.md): Durable history, latest snapshots, live data, and scoped producers.
- [Collector](https://tendriller.dev/docs/COLLECTOR.md): Local and SSH sources, projection, supervision, and retention.
- [Delivery and durability](https://tendriller.dev/docs/DURABILITY.md): Replay, explicit acknowledgement, and leased consumers.
- [CLI guide](https://tendriller.dev/cli/README.md): Optional installed CLI and safe pending/ack commands.
- [Snippets](https://tendriller.dev/snippets/README.md): Copyable browser controls and time-series charts.

## Downloads and examples

These Node.js 22.15+ helpers are standalone downloads. Save and run them locally;
keep credentials in private configuration files. They need no npm install.

- [Collector](https://tendriller.dev/tendril-stream.mjs): Run with a private collector configuration file.
- [Event reader](https://tendriller.dev/tendril-events.mjs): Read pending events, acknowledge diagnostic probes, and explicitly acknowledge handled application events.
- [Wake watcher](https://tendriller.dev/tendril-watch.mjs): Count-only wake notices for hosts with a session monitor.
- [Local preview](https://tendriller.dev/tendril-preview.mjs): Serve a page with the bundled real runtime and stream fixtures, without npm or a build. Headless scenarios use optional Playwright and Chromium.
- [Training dashboard](https://tendriller.dev/examples/training-dashboard/README.md): Downloadable setup and page source; usable without GitHub access.
- [Starter catalog](https://tendriller.dev/recipes/catalog.json): Complete pages, agent instructions, and local scenarios.

The optional full CLI and typed JavaScript client are available from the
[repository](https://github.com/werg/tendriller). A checkout is useful for
development; it is not required for the public API, local preview server,
standalone helpers, or dashboard setup.
